name: Yukimura Kiriko
source:
Arisa's best friend since childhood. She is half-Thai, and also came out as bisexual in 8th grade - both of which have made her a magnet for bullying. Arisa helped her out and they became lifelong friends. 
What started out as a "disguise" for her dark complexion, gyaru fashion is now her passion.

Favorite Color: Peach
Blood Type: O-
